title: Homomorphisms of topological rings and change-of-scalar functors
summary: We consider homomorphisms of complete, separated right or two-sided linear topological rings with countable bases of neighborhoods of zero $\mathfrak f\colon\mathfrak R\to\mathfrak S$. Taut maps of right linear topological rings, strongly right taut maps of two-sided linear topological rings, left proflat continuous ring maps, and topological ring epimorphisms are discussed.
